description: Offline English knowledge and conversation answers for IRA. Wikipedia is used when no entry matches.

answers.answer: Hello! I am IRA. It is good to hear from you. How can I help?
I am IRA, your Immersive Responsive Assistant. I can answer questions, search knowledge, speak with you, display avatars, and request approved local automations.
IRA stands for Immersive Responsive Assistant.
I can answer general questions, calculate expressions, search Wikipedia, recognize and speak multiple languages, load VRM avatars, and request approved computer tasks.
I am online and ready to help.
You are welcome. I am always ready to help.
Ask in English by typing or pressing the microphone. I can answer questions, perform calculations, search Wikipedia, and help with approved tasks.
Press the microphone button, allow microphone access, and begin speaking when the listening indicator appears.
Goodbye. I will be here whenever you need me.
Why did the computer visit the doctor? It had caught a virus.
VRM is a humanoid 3D avatar format based on glTF. IRA can load VRM 0.x and VRM 1.0 models locally in your browser.
Orb mode represents IRA as a voice-reactive animated neural core.
Persona mode presents IRA as a cinematic visual companion while keeping the same conversation features.
The automation bridge is a local Python service that performs only allowlisted computer actions after explicit confirmation.
VRM models are read locally by your browser and are not uploaded by the IRA interface.
Open Settings and use ‘How IRA addresses you’ to save your preferred name or title.
Open Settings and select a language. Automatic language detection can also switch recognition and speech for you.
Open Settings and choose Orb, Persona, or VRM under Interface mode.
Artificial intelligence is the field of building computer systems that perform tasks commonly associated with human intelligence, such as learning, reasoning, perception, and language understanding.
Machine learning is a branch of AI in which models learn patterns from data to make predictions or decisions without being programmed with every rule.
Deep learning uses multilayer neural networks to learn complex representations from large amounts of data.
A neural network is a computing model made of connected processing units arranged in layers that learn patterns by adjusting numerical weights.
An algorithm is a finite sequence of clear steps for solving a problem or completing a task.
Software is the collection of programs and data that instruct computer hardware what to do.
Hardware is the physical equipment of a computer system, including the processor, memory, storage, display, and input devices.
RAM is fast temporary memory used to hold programs and data currently being accessed. Its contents normally disappear when power is removed.
The CPU is the central processing unit that executes program instructions and coordinates much of a computer's work.
A GPU is a processor designed for highly parallel calculations, especially graphics rendering and many AI workloads.
An operating system manages computer hardware, applications, files, memory, processes, and user interaction.
Python is a readable, general-purpose programming language widely used for automation, web services, data analysis, and artificial intelligence.
JavaScript is the primary programming language of interactive web pages and is also used for servers, desktop applications, and mobile development.
JSON, or JavaScript Object Notation, is a lightweight text format for structured data using objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, and null.
An API is a defined interface that allows software systems to exchange data and request functionality from one another.
A database is an organized system for storing, querying, updating, and managing information.
Cloud computing provides servers, storage, databases, and software over a network on demand.
Open-source software makes its source code available under a license that permits inspection, modification, and redistribution.
Encryption transforms readable data into coded data that can be recovered only with the appropriate key.
Cybersecurity protects computers, networks, applications, and data from unauthorized access, damage, and disruption.
Use a long unique password or passphrase for every account, store it in a trusted password manager, and enable multifactor authentication.
Phishing is an attempt to steal information or install malware by impersonating a trusted person or organization.
The internet is a global network of interconnected computer networks that communicate using standardized protocols.
Wi-Fi is a family of wireless networking technologies used to connect devices to local networks and the internet.
Bluetooth is a short-range wireless standard for exchanging data between nearby devices.
Gravity is the attraction between objects with mass. Near Earth, it causes objects to accelerate toward the planet's center.
Light travels through a vacuum at exactly 299,792,458 metres per second.
An atom is the smallest unit of a chemical element that retains that element's properties. It contains a nucleus surrounded by electrons.
A molecule is a group of two or more atoms held together by chemical bonds.
Photosynthesis is the process by which plants, algae, and some bacteria use light energy to make chemical energy from carbon dioxide and water.
The sky appears blue because Earth's atmosphere scatters shorter blue wavelengths of sunlight more strongly than longer red wavelengths.
Water absorbs longer red wavelengths more strongly while blue light penetrates and is scattered back; reflected sky light also contributes.
DNA is the molecule that stores hereditary biological information in most living organisms.
A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of life.
Energy is the capacity of a physical system to perform work or produce change.
Electricity describes phenomena associated with electric charge, including the flow of charged particles through a conductor.
Renewable energy comes from naturally replenished sources such as sunlight, wind, flowing water, geothermal heat, and biomass.
Climate change is a long-term shift in climate patterns. The current rapid warming trend is primarily driven by human greenhouse-gas emissions.
The Solar System consists of the Sun and the objects gravitationally bound to it, including eight planets, dwarf planets, moons, asteroids, and comets.
There are eight recognized planets in the Solar System: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune.
Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.
Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun.
A black hole is a region where gravity is so strong that nothing crossing its event horizon can escape.

Quantum computing uses quantum states such as superposition and entanglement to process information. It may accelerate certain specialized problems but does not replace ordinary computers for every task.
Pi is the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter. Its approximate value is 3.141592653589793.
A prime number is a whole number greater than one with exactly two positive divisors: one and itself.
A percentage expresses a quantity as parts per hundred. For example, 25 percent is 25 divided by 100, or 0.25.
The area of a circle is pi multiplied by the square of its radius: A = πr².
The circumference of a circle is two times pi times its radius: C = 2πr.
The area of a rectangle is its length multiplied by its width.
For a right triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the other two sides: a² + b² = c².
New Delhi is the capital of India.
Tokyo is the capital of Japan.
Paris is the capital of France.
Berlin is the capital of Germany.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
Asia is the largest continent by both land area and population.
Mount Everest is Earth's highest mountain above sea level.
The Nile and Amazon are close competitors depending on measurement methods; the Nile is traditionally listed as the longest, while the Amazon carries the most water.
Choose one clear task, remove distractions, work for a timed interval, take a short break, and repeat. Sleep and regular exercise also support attention.
Use active recall, spaced repetition, practice problems, short focused sessions, and regular review instead of only rereading notes.
List your priorities, schedule the most important work, divide large tasks into small actions, and leave buffer time for interruptions.

keywords: how to make a good password
answers.answer: Generate a unique password of at least 16 characters with a password manager and enable multifactor authentication.
Use the 3-2-1 approach: keep three copies, on two different types of storage, with one copy off-site or in a trusted cloud service.
